prompt:
Create ONE high-fidelity portrait Android application UI mockup for Aira, an offline Filipino-speaking sari-sari store assistant. Flat front-on full screen, 390:844 aspect, no physical phone frame, no perspective, no hands, no scene background. Premium designed native Android screen, full-fidelity typography, realistic minimum 48dp controls, comfortable contrast, system sans-serif, clear hierarchy. This is a proposed redesign of the price-lookup screen, OPERATE mode: immediately find one product's correct price, review speech, type or correct if needed. Must feel warm, approachable, less formal, with an unmistakable unified theme.
Shared content and scenario, identical across options: status bar 9:41 with Android icons; small Aira brand plus compact 'Offline' badge; heading 'Magkano ito?'; search field containing 'Lucky Me'; one obvious microphone lookup action labeled 'Magsalita'; secondary typing/correction action 'I-edit ang hinahanap'. Large exact result: 'Lucky Me Pancit Canton', next line 'Chilimansi · 60 g · pakete', price '₱15.00' as dominant answer, small tag 'Nahanap sa paninda'. Supporting reminder 'Suriin ang variant at laki.' Tiny unobtrusive mock-data caption 'Halimbawang paninda'. Bottom native navigation with 3 destinations 'Presyo', 'Benta', 'Tindahan'; Presyo selected. Android gesture bar. Native Material-style navigational and interactive affordances, not iOS. No assistant chat bubbles, no avatars, no charts, no product photography, no web layout, no ornamental hero, no app screenshots or promotional claims. Text should be accurate and readable. Content continues logically if more than one viewport is needed, but image shows only this first viewport. Show the lookup UI doing its job, not a poster or color palette.
DIRECTION: PRICE TICKET. Structure: brand/app bar, conversational question, wide search field with small mic affordance at top. Middle result reads like a beautifully segmented utility ticket: navy (#16324F) title strip, quiet label 'Nahanap sa paninda', white product identity segment, a pale blue (#E8F0F8) variant/unit row, then a generous price segment with large tabular navy ₱15.00. No barcode, no QR, no airport terminology, no real ticket number. Warm apricot (#EAA263) Magsalita button anchors lower region, a friendly correction action follows. Pale neutral #F5F7FA background and stable horizontal alignment, clear distinct states, rounded native Android surfaces and full-size controls. Avoid administrative tiny text; the screen should feel helpful and conversational. Selected Presyo in navy-tonal navigation.
